title: Profiling adapter and seed-bank for model onboarding and profile publishing
creator: Emily Chen
description: Deliver a pluggable profiling adapter and a curated 'seed-bank' to improve model onboarding workflow and automated profile publishing. The adapter standardizes how eval runners expose metrics, traces, and provenance metadata so downstream profile generators can consume heterogeneous runner outputs (text, chat, rerankers, embedding-based tests) without per-runner glue. The seed-bank is a managed collection of dataset slices and prompt variants (with deterministic seeds and sampling metadata) that the harness can use to create reproducible profile snapshots for publishing. Goals: reduce manual mapping for new runners, improve profile repeatability across model versions, and enable publishing profiles with embedded provenance for rollback and pinning decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Implement a ProfilingAdapter interface shim that normalizes runner outputs to the profile generator contract (metrics, per-example traces, KV-cache hints, and sampling metadata)
Seed-bank service and CLI commands to register, tag, and retrieve deterministic dataset slices and prompt variants (include version and fingerprint)
Embedding-based dataset fingerprinting to detect near-duplicates and produce sampling weights for representative slices
Profile generator consumes ProfilingAdapter output and publishes a profile artifact with provenance metadata (dataset seed id, runner version, model revision, and config) to the catalog
CI integration: end-to-end test that runs a sample runner via the adapter, generates a profile, and validates published artifact schema
Documentation: Developer guide for onboarding a new eval runner using the adapter and adding entries to the seed-bank

design_decisions: Use a lightweight adapter contract (JSON schema) rather than language bindings to keep runner onboarding language-agnostic
Seed-bank entries contain: dataset_id, slice_query, seed_hash, embedding_fingerprint, provenance_uri, acl_tag
Fingerprint dimension: 128 floats stored as base64 string to balance discriminative power and storage cost
Profile artifact will embed minimal runner config and a pointer to full trace data to reduce catalog size
risks_mitigation: Risk: seed-bank accidental exposure of PII. Mitigation: enforce ACL tags and automated PII-scan job on registration
Risk: duplicate profiling work across teams. Mitigation: add seed-bank discoverability and tag-based ownership fields
Risk: adapter performance overhead. Mitigation: benchmarking target of <5% added latency and optional sampling for heavy traces
